name: Koldunic Sorcery (Way of Sorrow) — 3 Advanced — The Starvation of Marena

system.description:
By invoking Marena, wife of Kupala, the koldun summons the cold and starvation that is her domain. A frosty gale blasts the victim, leaving him emaciated as though he had just survived the coldest of winters — the cold symbolizing the passage of time in harsh conditions, and often leaving him too weak to contradict the koldun. As with all Way of Sorrow powers, a botch turns the effect back upon the koldun as if the victim had scored five successes.

System: The koldun's player spends a Willpower point and rolls Manipulation + Koldunism (difficulty equal to the target's Willpower). For each success, the victim takes two levels of bashing damage that can be soaked normally; in addition, vampiric victims lose one blood point for each of the koldun's successes.

MET System: Invoke the name of Marena and make your Way of Sorrow challenge (Social versus Willpower, Koldunism for retests). If you win, the subject suffers two levels of bashing damage (one in compressed scale) and, if a vampire, loses one Blood Trait. Additionally, for every two current Social Traits you have over your victim, the effect is more lethal: score another two health levels of damage and one Blood Trait loss. If your opponent has more Social Traits than you, there is no additional penalty beyond the usual risk of an overbid.
system.source: Clanbook: Tzimisce, Chapter Two: Ego and Evolution
